entry.title: Greasemonkey 4 Announcement
entry.content: Greasemonkey has been a Firefox extension for well over a decade, with version 0.3.5 dating from 2005. We've grown and changed a lot over that time. With the upcoming Firefox 57 release , we need to change even more. Mozilla is completely replacing the extension system in Firefox, to align with the budding Browser Extension standard, based on/shared with Google Chrome. entry.content: As mentioned in the main post , Greasemonkey 4 is changing to be compatible with the Browser Extension API. At its core, this set of APIs is completely asynchronous.
